question: Which independent soundtrack world can make strict cross-soundtrack Masanori Hikichi composer calibration testable without laundering team, arrangement, programming, or implementation credits into composition evidence?
claim_boundary: This is an execution/search record, not canonical composer admission. A candidate may become training evidence only after exact cue-level role evidence and immutable source bytes are both admitted through the normal corpus and attribution-control machinery.

candidates.role_result: licensed 2022 arrangement release gives cue-level composition partition
candidates.operational_blocker: The public VGMRips/Project2612 ZIP endpoint is visible but binary transfer is unavailable in the present execution environment. Do not synthesize or recreate the VGM bytes.

exact_control.evidence: TOCT-8181 credits the in-game original-version cue to Hikichi as composer and arranger; SRIN-1129 independently assigns PC Engine disc-1 track 22 to Hikichi.

candidates.operational_blocker: A public HES preservation exists, but retro-vgm-compiler currently has no HES execution/cache adapter. These cues are valuable precisely because they separate Hikichi composition from Hikichi arrangement inside one source world; do not reduce them to a team label.

candidates.role_result: original soundtrack partitions Hikichi composition to tracks 7, 10, 15, 26, 28, 30, and 37
candidates.operational_blocker: No Granstream corpus or PSF source adapter is present in this repository. Later Quintet-era production makes this a useful hard transfer world, but less direct than Gleylancer or 1993 Langrisser.

candidates.reason: The soundtrack has multiple sound contributors. Recovered TOCT-8252 cue-level evidence assigns composition of M-4 and M-8 to J.S.P and arrangement to Masanori Hikichi. Those cues are arrangement controls, not Hikichi composition controls.
candidates.reuse: Keep as team/arrangement/implementation validation; do not promote the whole committed battle-master-spc corpus to Hikichi composer supervision.

candidates.reason: Four named Sound Composers include Hikichi, but the surviving rip exposes anonymous BGM numbers and no defensible cue-level ownership partition was recovered.
candidates.reuse: Team-level validation only until exact cue ownership is documented.

candidates.reason: Five people are credited for Music. The 2008 EGG MUSIC original soundtrack preserves the same five at album scope, but no per-track composer partition was recovered.
candidates.reuse: Do not reinterpret album-level composer participation as cue-level Hikichi supervision.

candidates.reason: Genesis credits assign Music and FX jointly to Masanori Hikichi and Masayuki Nagao, while David Javelosa later identified his own additions. Current evidence does not partition the Japanese-authored cues between Hikichi and Nagao.
candidates.reuse: Useful shared-author and implementation control; not an individual Hikichi composer anchor.

candidates.reason: The port credits Hikichi for S.E. / Music, while inherited musical works are credited to Koichi Namiki and/or Katsuhiro Hayashi.

result.why: Gleylancer already matches the existing Genesis ingestion stack and supplies two Hikichi positives plus a same-game Iwadare decoy. Langrisser supplies unusually clean composer-versus-arranger role separation but requires an HES adapter.
